scope: Isolated SELECT-body, decoded-check and source-byte probes, not complete-file conformance tests. Both missed invalid controls and flagged valid controls are findings. Mixed LF/CRLF expected acceptance is a continued-review interpretation, not an owner-approved decision.

seedProbes.ruleMessage: Records for one CHROM must form a contiguous record-index block.
Record positions must be nondecreasing within a CHROM block.
Individual record identifiers must be unique across records.
Structured header-line ID attributes must be unique within their header type.

Sample names and sample indices must be unique within a VCF file's SampleSet.
GT must be the first FORMAT key when it is present.
